SELECT r.review_coach_idx, r.reviewer_idx, r.reviewee_idx, r.rating, r.tag, r.content, r.created_at,
NVL(c.nickname, u.user_name) AS reviewee_name, NVL(c.photo, cp.photo) AS reviewee_photo,
CASE WHEN u.user_type = 'COMPANY' THEN '기업' WHEN u.user_type = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' WHEN u.user_type = 'coach' THEN NVL(rk.rank_name, '일반 코치') ELSE '일반' END AS reviewee_label
FROM review_coach r JOIN users u ON u.user_idx = r.reviewee_idx LEFT JOIN coach c ON c.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN company cp ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN rank rk ON u.user_type = 'coach' AND ( (rk.min_score IS NULL OR c.point_score >= rk.min_score) AND (rk.max_score IS NULL OR c.point_score <= rk.max_score) ) WHERE r.reviewer_idx = #{user_idx} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.review_coach_idx, r.reviewer_idx, r.reviewee_idx, r.rating, r.tag, r.content, r.created_at,
NVL(c.nickname, u.user_name) AS reviewer_name, NVL(c.photo, cp.photo) AS reviewer_photo,
CASE WHEN u.user_type = 'COMPANY' THEN '기업' WHEN u.user_type = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' WHEN u.user_type = 'coach' THEN NVL(rk.rank_name, '일반 코치') ELSE '일반' END AS reviewer_label
FROM review_coach r JOIN users u ON u.user_idx = r.reviewer_idx LEFT JOIN coach c ON c.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN company cp ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN rank rk ON u.user_type = 'coach' AND ( (rk.min_score IS NULL OR c.point_score >= rk.min_score) AND (rk.max_score IS NULL OR c.point_score <= rk.max_score) ) WHERE r.reviewee_idx = #{user_idx} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT rc.review_class_idx, rc.reviewer_idx, rc.class_idx, rc.rating, rc.tag, rc.content, rc.created_at, cl.title AS class_title,
NVL(c.nickname, pu.user_name) AS provider_name, NVL(c.photo, pc.photo) AS provider_photo,
CASE WHEN pu.user_type = 'COMPANY' THEN '기업' WHEN pu.user_type = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' WHEN pu.user_type = 'coach' THEN NVL(prk.rank_name, '일반 코치') ELSE '일반' END AS provider_label
FROM review_class rc JOIN class cl ON cl.class_idx = rc.class_idx
JOIN users pu ON pu.user_idx = cl.provider_idx LEFT JOIN coach c ON c.user_idx = pu.user_idx LEFT JOIN company pc ON pc.user_idx = pu.user_idx LEFT JOIN rank prk ON pu.user_type = 'coach' AND ( (prk.min_score IS NULL OR c.point_score >= prk.min_score) AND (prk.max_score IS NULL OR c.point_score <= prk.max_score) )
WHERE rc.reviewer_idx = #{user_idx} ORDER BY rc.created_at DESC

SELECT rc.review_class_idx, rc.reviewer_idx, rc.class_idx, rc.rating, rc.tag, rc.content, rc.created_at, cl.title AS class_title,
NVL(c.nickname, ru.user_name) AS reviewer_name, NVL(c.photo, rcp.photo) AS reviewer_photo,
CASE WHEN ru.user_type = 'COMPANY' THEN '기업' WHEN ru.user_type = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' WHEN ru.user_type = 'coach' THEN NVL(rrk.rank_name, '일반 코치') ELSE '일반' END AS reviewer_label
FROM review_class rc JOIN class cl ON cl.class_idx = rc.class_idx
JOIN users ru ON ru.user_idx = rc.reviewer_idx LEFT JOIN coach c ON c.user_idx = ru.user_idx LEFT JOIN company rcp ON rcp.user_idx = ru.user_idx LEFT JOIN rank rrk ON ru.user_type = 'coach' AND ( (rrk.min_score IS NULL OR c.point_score >= rrk.min_score) AND (rrk.max_score IS NULL OR c.point_score <= rrk.max_score) )
WHERE cl.provider_idx = #{provider_idx} ORDER BY rc.created_at DESC

SELECT RC.REVIEW_COACH_IDX, RC.CONTENT, RC.RATING, RC.CREATED_AT, C.user_idx as reviewer_idx, C.nickname, C.photo, C.point_score as score, RT.content as tag_content FROM review_coach RC JOIN coach C ON RC.reviewer_idx = C.user_idx LEFT JOIN review_tag RT ON (RC.review_coach_idx = RT.review_tag_idx AND RT.review_type = 'COACH') WHERE RC.reviewee_idx = #{target_idx} ORDER BY RC.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM ( SELECT RC.REVIEW_COACH_IDX AS review_coach_idx, RC.REVIEWER_IDX AS reviewer_idx, RC.REVIEWEE_IDX AS reviewee_idx, RC.RATING AS rating, RC.TAG AS tag, RC.CONTENT AS content, RC.CREATED_AT AS created_at, C.nickname AS reviewer_name, C.photo AS photo, C.point_score AS score FROM review_coach RC JOIN coach C ON RC.reviewer_idx = C.user_idx WHERE RC.reviewee_idx = #{target_idx} ) T ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
